name: OpenDocRouter
desc: One API that routes document parsing across open and frontier models.
desc_zh: 用一个 API 在开源与前沿模型之间路由文档解析。
solves: Every document task needs a different parser and a different prompt recipe; one endpoint picks the model and recipe for you.
solves_zh: 每种文档任务都要不同的解析器和提示词配方；一个端点替你选好模型和配方。
best_for: You are parsing invoices, forms or PDFs and keep re-tuning the extractor per document type.
best_for_zh: 你在解析发票、表单或 PDF，并按文档类型反复调抽取器。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — llamaindex.ai/blog）。 Blog post carries JSON-LD datePublished 2026-10-07; the page itself renders no visible date, so the structured-data date is used.
